prompt: Challenge C124-CH2: One of our Austrian clients moved to a cloud accounting platform last year and now wants us to migrate their 12 years of legacy desktop data

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Automated schema matching and data integration methods can handle structural variations across heterogeneous data exports by using constraint propagation and ontology-driven approaches.","sources":[{"id":"R0181","field":"bio","quote":"Her group develops methods for ontology-driven data integration, probabilistic record linkage, and data quality assessment over tabular and semi-structured data."},{"id":"SYN-PUB-02340","field":"abstract","quote":"introduces a framework that encodes integrity constraints as logical predicates and uses constraint propagation to narrow the space of candidate correspondences"}]},{"text":"Schema drift detection and incremental re-matching can be automated to identify and resolve structural changes in streaming or batch data without exhaustive manual intervention.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02348","field":"abstract","quote":"uses a sliding-window change detector to identify structural drift in incoming streams and triggers targeted re-matching only for affected schema fragments"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-02348","field":"abstract","quote":"automated re-matching resolved 11 without human intervention"}]},{"text":"ERP and legacy accounting system exports exhibit systematic schema patterns that cause matcher failures, but pre-matching normalisation rules can substantially improve automatic resolution rates.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02347","field":"abstract","quote":"A taxonomy of 12 recurring schema patterns is introduced, covering code-column concatenation, multi-valued delimited cells, silent null conventions"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-02347","field":"abstract","quote":"application raises average matcher precision by 0.12 across all three systems"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's work on automated schema matching, constraint-based integration, and ERP export normalisation directly addresses the challenge of handling evolving legacy export formats; prior consultancy on legacy system ERP migration [R0181] and published analysis of systematic ERP schema patterns [SYN-PUB-02347] provide both methodological and domain-specific expertise applicable to the accounting data migration pipeline."}
